reeval VERSION — Evaluation runner for SDKs, CLIs, MCP servers, and docs.

Usage: reeval <command> [options]

Get started:
  init [dir]                Create a reeval project
  doctor                    Check your setup and print fixes

Run evals:
  run [filter...]           Run evals
  attach [run|file|url]     Follow a run's output
  clean                     Remove local debug data, snapshots and event streams

Results:
  record [run...]           Copy runs to the history folder
  history [filter]          Show pass/fail per eval over recent runs
  show [run]                Show a run
  compare [base] [head]     Compare two runs
  checkout [run] [dir]      Check out a run's code as a git worktree
  sync [run...]             Sync runs with the history store
  query [sql | view]        Query run history with SQL or a named view
  analyze [run]             Explain a run with an LLM
  report [run]              Collect a redacted bug report

Studio and agents:
  mcp                       Serve run history over MCP
  studio [run]              Open runs in the studio, or share them

Images:
  image                     Build, list and clean sandbox images

Global options:
  --config <path>           Config file (default: nearest reeval.config.ts)
  -h, --help                Show help
  --version                 Print the version

Run reeval <command> --help for a command's options.
